name: Cortez & Associates
imageAlt: Cortez & Associates website shown on a desktop display
body: We partnered with Cortez & Associates, a trusted tax and business advisory firm based in Southern California, to design a clean, modern website that reflects their professionalism, expertise, and long-standing client relationships. Founded by seasoned accountant Luis Cortez, the firm serves individuals and businesses across California with a focus on clarity, compliance, and custom strategy.

The new site is designed to communicate trust and authority while making it easy for visitors to explore a wide range of services — from tax planning and audit support to outsourced CFO solutions and startup consulting. With an intuitive layout, service-focused content, and strong calls to action, the website now serves as a polished, client-ready hub for both new and existing relationships.
Cortez & Associates is well-positioned online to continue delivering the high-level advisory and financial guidance their clients have relied on for over a decade.
result: Traffic increased by 17% in the first 30 days.
